title: FG-TIDA R04 contribution material (working drafts)
description:
Working drafts of material intended for contribution to ITU-T FG-TIDA. Not adopted by any standards body. Not submitted. Cite a specific file at a specific commit, and state that it is a draft.

Files: supporter positioning (C1-C8), the R04 insertion draft proposing a revocation_establishment field, a support package with five worked examples and a JSON Schema sketch, and two self-contained browser demos.
notes: Working drafts. Not adopted by any standards body. Not submitted as of 2026-11-17. Statements inside the drafts are subject to the primary source on the day of citation.
